'''Alec Mard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zhanox/Legends|Zhanox]]. He eventually joined the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mard participated in arresting the rogue Wing Guard<ref name="SWI" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Wilber Flagesso]], and became one of the most loyal Wing Guard members following the event. Alec Mard had fair skin. During his service in the Bespin Wing Guard, he wore the standard uniform,<ref name="SWI" /> and wielded a [[Relby-k23 blaster pistol]].<ref name="Image">Promotional image for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] &ndash; full version of ''Insider'' image</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Portrayed by an uncredited actor, Alec Mard appeared in promotional photos for [[1980]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], though it is unclear if he was visible in the film itself. In [[2014]], he was first named and given a brief backstory in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] feature of [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]].
